title: Why Joel Miller stopped caring in The Last of Us
subject: joel
description:
Would you have survived what Joel lost? 👇

The night that turned Joel Miller into the hardened survivor of The Last of Us. Spoilers for The Last of Us Part I.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Naughty Dog or Sony Interactive Entertainment. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Joel lost his daughter on the very first night of the outbreak.
Hours earlier, twelve-year-old Sarah had given him a birthday watch.
Fleeing Austin with his brother Tommy, they met a soldier ordered to shoot.
Sarah died in Joel's arms, and part of him died with her.
But that's not the worst part. For twenty years, he survived by letting no one close.
Then he was paid to smuggle a girl named Ellie, and his walls began to crack.
And it all started with one shot on a dark highway.
